description: This file provides a data service module for managing user sessions, profiles, requests, and fees, with support for both localStorage-based mock mode and optional integration with Supabase for backend data storage.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Resolves the current session and user info, either from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: getCurrentProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile from the database or local storage.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new service request, either in Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clearing session data.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's info.

methods.name: approveMechanic
methods.description: Approves a mechanic user, updating their role and approval status.

methods.name: updateRequest
methods.description: Updates a specific request's status or assigned mechanic.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Supabase environment variables are set.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient
methods.description: Returns a Supabase client instance if configured.

methods.name: getMyProfile
methods.description: Loads the current user's profile from Supabase.
